# Oliver Abraham — Product & Business

> Independent practical product and business improvement for owner-managed manufacturing, joinery, furniture and building-product businesses in the UK.

## Main page
- [Oliver Abraham — Product & Business](https://oliverabraham.co.uk/): services, approach, background, first-day offer and contact.

## Services
- Product design and engineering; cost and value engineering; CAD, drawings and technical process; range and SKU simplification; manufacturing methods; product information and specifications; training and work instructions; testing and practical investigation; job and administrative process; small internal software tools; useful automation; supplier and project coordination.

## Engagement
One on-site working day in the UK, UK travel included, followed by written observations and practical recommendations. Current published fee: £1,200. Follow-on work is scoped separately.

## Suitable clients
Owner-managed manufacturing and businesses in joinery, furniture, building products and related physical-product sectors.
